alsoGreen.intent: Structured Text instead of Ladder: the same three conditions as boolean expressions

files.src/TwoHandLd.st:
PROGRAM TwoHandLd
VAR_INPUT LeftHand AT %I0.0 : BOOL; RightHand AT %I0.1 : BOOL; GuardClosed AT %I0.2 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT PressEnable AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; GuardLamp AT %Q0.1 : BOOL; OneHandWarning AT %Q0.2 : BOOL; END_VAR
PressEnable := LeftHand AND RightHand AND GuardClosed; GuardLamp := NOT GuardClosed; OneHandWarning := LeftHand XOR RightHand;
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: enables the press with either hand: Left and Right are in parallel
forgets the guard in the PressEnable rung
warns whenever any hand is on: the two paths of the warning rung are not exclusive
shows the lamp with a normally open contact, so it lights while the guard is closed
